resources.string: Lets TurboVoice insert transcribed speech into whatever text field is currently focused, in whatever app is open — triggered by pressing your chosen trigger key, set from the app\'s main screen. It only acts on that press; it does not read or record anything otherwise.
Press the key you want to use as your trigger.\n\nPress Back to cancel.
